start: Owner of a gym with 2 branches, online, nothing waiting to be sent, on Today

steps.action: Open the Branch list at the top of the panel
user_sees: "All branches" then each branch's name
must_not: A branch of another owner's business listed

steps.action: Pick the other branch
user_sees: "Opening the branch…" under the list
The panel opens again on Today of that branch
must_not: Screens still showing the first branch's members
A sign-in screen

steps.action: Go to Settings → Branches
user_sees: Both branches with "Gym code … · receipts start …"; "Open now" on the branch just picked
must_not: "Open now" on two branches

steps.action: Tap "Open" on another branch in "Each branch"
user_sees: That branch's Today
must_not: The open branch unchanged with no message

steps.action: Open the Branch list
user_sees: The branch now selected
must_not: The list showing the old branch

start: Owner; the key this device kept for branch B was signed out from the device list

steps.action: Pick branch B in the Branch list
user_sees: "Opening the branch…", then branch B opens with no extra sign-in
must_not: "Sign in first." or a sign-out of the whole device
A red line when a fresh key could be made

start: Owner with 2 branches, internet off or entries waiting to be sent

steps.action: Look at the Branch list while offline
user_sees: The list is greyed out; its description says the internet is needed
must_not: The list opens and a switch is tried offline

steps.action: Back online with entries still waiting
user_sees: "Another branch opens when everything saved on this device is sent." under the list
must_not: The switch allowed while this branch's entries wait

steps.action: A switch the server refuses
user_sees: A red line with plain words, e.g. "Branches are not switched on for your gym yet. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp."
must_not: A raw database message

steps.action: Pick the first branch again
user_sees: Today of the first branch; "Open now" moves back in Settings → Branches
must_not: Branch B's data on the first branch's screens

steps.action: Add a third branch in Settings → Branches
user_sees: The Branch list now has three names
must_not: The new branch missing until a reload

start: A gym with 2 branches; a front-desk person of branch A signed in

steps.action: The desk person looks at the top of the panel
user_sees: Only the gym name, no Branch list
must_not: A way to open branch B
Branch B's members

steps.action: The owner signs out on a shared laptop and someone else signs in there
user_sees: Only their own gym
must_not: The owner's kept branch keys used for the new person
